notes.title: Steam Release
notes.notes:
Hi steam community!

We're really happy to announce the release of Dark Mechanism on Steam for Oculus Rift and HTC Vive. 

We were aiming for something different in terms of gameplay than what we are used to seeing in VR games currently. We like to have fun in VR like everyone else, so we hope that you enjoy the game and have lots of fun too.

If you have any comments, feedback and suggestions please let us know. We're very active in our VR work so we like to chat with people, get ideas, understand what you like and what you don't like. 
It's all very helpful for us in order to make progress. We are finishing a new game currently that we'll publish soon, and it's progress has been moulded by the feedback we have got on our previous games. The games aren't just for us, they are for you so we aim to take all feedback into account!

Enjoy!

FOV team
